description: FIN-35 EU-AO (V123): the AdminOps kit console (ces-ao/ui at /app/, FIN-30) on S2 (a fictional engineering-services subcontractor). The twin is E7A (out/adminops-e7a.json): each of the scenario's adminops_ops, in order, through the console: open the command, pick the simulated tenant, parameters from the registry record, DRY RUN then APPLY; two-person approval off. The sim is reset and the store E7A started from (out/sim-store-e7a-pre.json) restored; AO runs on a private pipeline and tenant root. Watched by default (headed, paced, captioned, video and trace); --headless for unattended rounds. Record: out/ui-e2e-ao.json.
